title: Undo Damage (Ctrl+Z)
description: Ctrl+Z reverses the last hit point change - damage, healing or temp HP - and Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z re-applies it. Works with automatic damage, the Apply tray, right-click damage menus and hand edits on a sheet. When there is no hit point change left to undo the keypress falls through to Foundry's own canvas undo, so it never gets in the way.
